figures.alt: Matching vinyl siding profile samples beside an intact Florida exterior wall
figures.caption: A cracked or storm-damaged panel rarely means the whole run must be replaced. Match the color, profile, and locking edge before ordering material.

figures.alt: Window opening with sill flashing and weather-resistive barrier before exterior trim
figures.caption: Keep the replacement panel level before engaging the locking edge. A small error can telegraph through the wall and hide a larger water-control issue behind the siding.

figures.alt: Finished exterior trim and siding transition on a Florida home
figures.caption: If the wall behind a panel is soft or the surrounding siding is brittle, inspect the wider envelope before buying another piece that will not solve the cause.
